split_rule: Paraphrase clusters are assigned to exactly one source split before TTS. Synthetic voices are disjoint by split: shubh/train, simran/dev, aditya/test.
training_policy: Train only on synthetic_train. Do not use synthetic_calibration or synthetic_final_test for fitting.
calibration_policy: Tune thresholds and reject-gate parameters only on synthetic_calibration.
final_test_policy: Evaluate once on synthetic_final_test after model and threshold selection. unseen_combined is test-only.
public_data_policy: IndicVoices records with review_status=unreviewed and label_provenance=keyword_derived_candidate are excluded from trusted metrics until human review.

synthetic_asr_pool.purpose: ASR transcript generation only; classifier roles use the three frozen manifests

public_trusted.policy: Only explicitly reviewed labels with non-derived provenance are eligible. Current count is zero until review is completed.

public_curated_candidates.purpose: Audit and human-review queue only; excluded from trusted metrics until review_status is explicitly reviewed.
